# Midnite Systems

> Midnite Systems (MDNT) is an AI consultancy and deployment agency for growing businesses. We map your operation with the Roadmap, build the AI that genuinely fits, then run it for you as a managed service. We don't just advise: we build, deploy, and operate.

Midnite Systems was built by operators running businesses of their own, not by advisors theorizing about them. Every engagement starts with the Roadmap: an audit of your operation, identification of where AI genuinely fits, and a written plan with prioritized opportunities, build-vs-buy guidance, sequencing, and budget framing, including SaaS recommendations we don't sell. The plan is yours to act on with us or on your own.

## Solutions

- [Solutions overview](https://midnitesystems.com/solutions): The three ways Midnite Systems deploys AI once the Roadmap points the way.
- [Custom Employee Build](https://midnitesystems.com/solutions/custom-employee-build): Bespoke AI employees deployed into your operation, junior, specialist, or executive. An employee, not a chatbot: a role definition, a workflow, integrations, and a measurable output, run on the managed operating layer.
- [Custom Workspace Build](https://midnitesystems.com/solutions/custom-workspace-build): A client-specific UI or internal portal connected to the platform, where your team and AI employees work side by side. Replaces subscription sprawl and load-bearing spreadsheets.
- [AI Strategy Support](https://midnitesystems.com/solutions/ai-strategy-support): Ongoing strategic consulting beyond the Roadmap, as dedicated hours or on-demand. An advisor on call, not a one-time deck.

## Case studies

- [DSI Transportation](https://midnitesystems.com/case-studies/dsi-transportation): Cut monthly operating overhead from $22,500 to $10,000 (56%) by replacing 16 recurring tasks with AI employees running 7 days a week. $150,000 saved annualized. First live agent deployed 4 weeks after the Roadmap.

## Get started

- [Book a discovery call](https://midnitesystems.com/discovery): 30 minutes to map where AI deployment can pull the most weight in your business. No pitch deck, no obligation.
